sentences.text: 1. Heard Sri Ashok Kumar Maurya, learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application has been preferred for quashing of charge-sheet dated 30.06.2012,
cognizance/summoning order dated 24.12.2023 as well as the entire proceedings of Case No.40902 of 2013 (State of U.P. vs. Ganga Sagar and Others) arising out of Case Crime No.219 of 2011, under sections 419, 420, 120B IPC, P.S. sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the alleged incident has been occurred way back on 14.06.2011, whereupon FIR has been registered on dated 22.06.2011, wherein the applicant was not implicated at the time of lodging of the FIR, but during the course of investigation, the name of applicant has been apparent and at the time of preferring charge-sheet it is applicant who has been implicated being the truck owner through which certain accident has been caused.
4.

Learned counsel for the applicant also submitted that the applicant cannot be implicated since he purchased the said truck bearing registration no. UP-64-E-5363 on dated 28.05.2012 and the same is apparent from the details available over the official website of Regional Transport Office pertains to Registration no. UP-64-E-5363, it is also apparent from the same record that from 01.01.2005 to 27.05.2012, owner of the same truck number was Mangla Singh, S/o Sri Ram Nagina Singh and as such implication of applicant along with summoning order in the instant case is highly illegal.
5. Per contra, learned AGA vehemently opposed the prayer as made through instant application but did not dispute the record which has been extracted from the official website of Regional Transport Office, District Ballia and the same aspect has never been detailed or inquired either by the Investigating Officer or by the learned court concerned.
6.

In view of aforementioned facts and circumstances, once it is crystal clear that the ownership in favour of applicant of truck no. UP-64-E-5363 initiated from 28.05.2012, the applicant cannot be held liable for any incident whatsoever has been caused by the same truck before 28.05.2012.
The implication of applicant in pursuance to summoning order dated 24.12.2013 for putting him under trial shall be misuse of the process of law for implicating the person for no cause of action.

7. In view of above, the entire proceedings of Case No.40902 of 2013 (State of U.P. vs. Ganga Sagar and Others) arising out of Case Crime No.219 of 2011, under sections 419, 420, 120B IPC, P.S.
Kotwali, District- Ballia, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ballia, including Ganga Sagar Alias Ganga Sagar Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12419607/
2 charge-sheet dated 30.06.2012 and cognizance/summoning order dated 24.12.2023, are hereby set-aside in respect of applicant only.
8.
